editorial:
If you love gritty crime stories with tough cops and clever crooks, this one pulls you right in. The story follows a hard-nosed LA sheriff's unit chasing a crew of bank robbers who plan to hit the Federal Reserve. The vibe is raw and intense, with a cat-and-mouse feel that keeps you guessing who is really in control. Gerard Butler plays the lead cop with a rough edge, and the robbers feel smart and dangerous, making every scene feel like it matters.

The action is loud and well shot, and the pacing stays strong even when the movie slows down for character moments. Some scenes run a bit long, and the story can feel heavy at times, but the payoff is worth it. If you enjoy heist films like Heat or The Town, you will have a good time here. Watch it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best sound.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the crew pulls off the Federal Reserve heist, but the cops close in. A shootout erupts, and several robbers are killed. The twist reveals that one robber, Donnie, was actually working with the police the whole time. He walks away with the money while the rest of the crew is taken down. The lead cop realizes too late that he was played, leaving the ending with a bitter, surprising turn.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime thrillers and heist movies.
